_meta.description: Integration-test seed fixture for slice-01 of the bookkeeping-waterschappen-bbv-variant chain. Mirrors the demo seed in lib/Settings/seeds/bbv-waterschappen-programmes-2026-demo.json (5 BBVProgramme records + 5 BudgetBBVMapping records for fiscal year 2026) plus the minimal GLTransaction + GLLine fixture pair the later chain members (02 aggregation, 08 compliance service, 11 testing) consume to assert the rollup result. The single administrationId 'adm-waterschap-1' scopes every record, matching the seed loader's natural-key dedupe behaviour. Money fields are integer euro cents per ADR-022.

BBVProgramme.description: Core administrative programme covering general administration, board support and shared services.
Human resources, payroll, training and personnel administration across the waterboard.
Surface- and ground-water quality monitoring, sampling and laboratory analysis aligned with the Kaderrichtlijn Water programme.
Asset maintenance and renewal across pumping stations, weirs, sluices and other water-system infrastructure.
Long-range strategic planning, climate-adaptation roadmaps and investment programming.
